groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Local rows are Fifth Judicial District and Circuit judges serving Big Horn with Hot Springs and Washakie (Bobbi Overfield, Ed Luhm / Edward G. Luhm) and the Park-seat judges (Bill Simpson, Joey Darrah), from official court roster titles already used in the official Park and Washakie histories. Official 2026 Big Horn canvass retention for Judge Bobbi Overfield is YES 2,876 / NO 722. Official 2026 RETAIN JUDGE BEN BURNINGHAM is the statewide Chancery Court retention already in the shared terms, not a Fifth Judicial District circuit office.
